coverage_rule: Every named speech/omni candidate in the four bounded source inventories receives exactly one explicit analysis role; this is not a literature-universe or novelty claim.

source_inventories.coverage_claim: All 451 local PDFs were extracted; the 14 named speech-agent rescue decisions are routed below.
All 529 nonlocal records passing the disclosed high-recall root gate were routed; all 53 named manual decisions are explicit below.
Every named speech/omni direct prior or trained boundary in the opening D2 set is routed below.
The reviewer-relevant JarvisBench identity in the bounded delta D2 set is explicitly routed below.
